include: All human medicinal products marketed or officially registered in Egypt, whether locally manufactured or imported
All distinct strengths, dosage forms, routes and pack presentations
Locally marketed vaccines and biological medicines where authoritative product data is available
exclude_or_separate: Medical devices, cosmetics and personal-care products (separate catalogue)
Food supplements and herbal products unless classified and verified as medicines by the relevant Egyptian authority
scope.identity_rule: Each distinct Egyptian marketed product, strength, dosage form and pack presentation must be independently identifiable. Do not merge products merely because they share an active ingredient.

coverage_status.note: Zero means no product records have yet passed source and clinical review in this repository. It does not mean zero medicines exist in Egypt.

ingestion_requirements: Obtain an authoritative product list or permitted data feed from the Egyptian Drug Authority or another legally authorized source.
Confirm terms of use, licence, API/bulk-download permission and attribution requirements before ingestion.
Preserve the source's original product identifiers and record source snapshots and import dates.
Normalize Arabic/English trade names, ingredient names, strengths, dosage forms and manufacturers without losing original values.
Deduplicate using regulatory identifier where available plus manufacturer, ingredients, strength, form and pack presentation.
Keep unverified candidates out of public search until product identity and evidence are reviewed.
Maintain dated price observations separately from stable product identity.
Run automated schema validation and human pharmacist review before publication.
search_requirements: Search by Arabic or English brand name
Search by active ingredient (Arabic transliteration and INN)
Filter by strength, dosage form and route
Support common spelling variants and aliases
Clearly distinguish exact same-ingredient alternatives from therapeutic alternatives
